definition: Worth a very large amount; extremely useful.
examples: The museum has a priceless painting.
Her advice was priceless.
The look on his face was priceless.

spanish.definition: Que vale muchísimo; extremadamente útil.

definition: A person who enters a place without permission.
examples: The dog barked at the intruder.
An intruder broke in through the window.
The alarm warns you about intruders.

spanish.definition: Persona que entra a un lugar sin permiso.

definition: Large in amount.
examples: The trip cost a considerable amount of money.
She has considerable experience.
He spent considerable time on the project.

spanish.definition: De gran cantidad.

definition: Connected to women or thought to be typical of women.
examples: She has a very feminine style.
This dress is soft and feminine.
In Spanish, the word for house is feminine.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con las mujeres o considerado típico de ellas.

definition: A clear understanding of something.
examples: The book gives us an insight into her life.
He has great insight into people.
Thanks for your insights.

spanish.definition: Comprensión clara de algo.

definition: A building where Muslims pray.
examples: There's a big mosque in the city center.
He goes to the mosque on Fridays.
We took off our shoes before we entered the mosque.

spanish.definition: Edificio donde rezan los musulmanes.

definition: Many times.
examples: I've told you repeatedly not to do that.
He called her repeatedly.
She repeatedly asked for help.

spanish.definition: Muchas veces.

definition: Connected to the very cold area around the North Pole; very cold.
examples: Polar bears live in the Arctic.
Arctic winds are blowing over the city.
We studied arctic animals in class.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la zona muy fría del Polo Norte; muy frío.

definition: Less important; coming after the first.
examples: Price is a secondary issue.
The secondary road was closed.
He teaches at a secondary school.

spanish.definition: Menos importante; que viene después del primero.

definition: Open to new ideas; a person with these ideas.
examples: Her parents are very liberal.
He has liberal views on most issues.
She's a liberal from California.

spanish.definition: Abierto a ideas nuevas; persona con estas ideas.

definition: Hot liquid rock from a volcano.
examples: Lava flowed down the mountain.
The town was covered with lava.
Lava is extremely hot.

spanish.definition: Roca líquida y caliente de un volcán.

definition: To touch someone lightly to make them laugh.
examples: Dad tickled the baby's feet.
Stop! Don't tickle me!
She was tickling her little brother.

spanish.definition: Tocar a alguien con suavidad para hacerlo reír.

definition: A time when you have to be home.
examples: My curfew is at eleven.
The city set a curfew after the riots.
He got home after curfew.

spanish.definition: Hora en que debes estar en casa.

definition: Equal to something else.
examples: One mile is the equivalent of 1.6 kilometers.
Is there an equivalent word in Spanish?
He has a college degree or equivalent experience.

spanish.definition: Igual a otra cosa.

definition: False or one-sided information used to control what people think.
examples: The government used propaganda during the war.
Don't believe that propaganda.
The posters are pure propaganda.

spanish.definition: Información falsa o parcial usada para controlar lo que piensa la gente.

definition: The step or area just outside a door.
examples: The package is on the doorstep.
She stood on the doorstep and rang the bell.
We found a kitten on our doorstep.

spanish.definition: Escalón o área justo afuera de una puerta.

definition: Not afraid of anything.
examples: She's a fearless climber.
The little boy is completely fearless.
He was a fearless leader.

spanish.definition: Que no le tiene miedo a nada.

definition: Using new ideas or methods.
examples: It's an experimental drug.
The band plays experimental music.
The project is still at an experimental stage.

spanish.definition: Que usa ideas o métodos nuevos.

definition: A woman in stories with the tail of a fish.
examples: My daughter loves mermaids.
The story is about a mermaid who lives in the sea.
She dressed up as a mermaid for Halloween.

spanish.definition: Mujer de los cuentos con cola de pez.

definition: To take something out.
examples: The dentist extracted my tooth.
Oil is extracted from the ground.
They're extracting data from the old computer.

spanish.definition: Sacar algo.

definition: The state of being together as one group.
examples: The president called for national unity.
There's a strong sense of unity in the team.
Music brings unity to the town.

spanish.definition: Estado de estar juntos como un solo grupo.

definition: Money given regularly, especially to a child.
examples: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
He spent his allowance on candy.
The company gives us an allowance for travel.

spanish.definition: Dinero que se da regularmente, sobre todo a un niño.

definition: Not working or not being used.
examples: The machines are sitting idle.
Don't leave the car idle for too long.
He hates being idle.

spanish.definition: Que no trabaja o no se está usando.

definition: In the same way; me too.
examples: She said it was nice to meet me, and I said likewise.
She sat down, and I did likewise.
The food was great, and the service likewise.

spanish.definition: De la misma manera; yo también.

definition: A funny or difficult question with a clever answer.
examples: Can you solve this riddle?
The kids love riddles.
Stop talking in riddles.

spanish.definition: Pregunta chistosa o difícil con una respuesta ingeniosa.

definition: A part that controls the flow of a liquid or gas.
examples: Turn off the water at the valve.
He has a problem with a valve in his heart.
The gas valve is under the sink.

spanish.definition: Parte que controla el paso de un líquido o un gas.

definition: A person who loves computers or a special subject.
examples: My brother is a computer geek.
She's a real movie geek.
The geeks in my class built a robot.

spanish.definition: Persona a la que le encantan las computadoras o un tema especial.

definition: A person who enters a building to steal.
examples: A burglar broke into our house.
The burglar took my laptop.
The dog scared away the burglars.

spanish.definition: Persona que entra a un edificio para robar.

definition: A very young baby.
examples: She's holding her infant son.
The infant slept all night.
Infants need a lot of sleep.

spanish.definition: Bebé muy pequeño.

definition: To make someone feel ashamed in front of others.
examples: He humiliated me in front of my friends.
She didn't want to humiliate him.
The team was humiliated 8-0.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien sienta vergüenza frente a otros.

definition: A hot sauce made from meat juices.
examples: We had turkey and gravy for Thanksgiving.
Pour some gravy on your potatoes.
This gravy is delicious.

spanish.definition: Salsa caliente hecha con los jugos de la carne.

definition: A way of describing something by calling it something else.
examples: The phrase "time is money" is a metaphor.
The poem is full of metaphors.
He used a sports metaphor in his speech.

spanish.definition: Manera de describir algo llamándolo con otro nombre.

definition: The first year of school, for children about five years old.
examples: My son starts kindergarten in the fall.
She teaches kindergarten.
We've been friends since kindergarten.

spanish.definition: Primer año de escuela, para niños de unos cinco años.

definition: A person who has left home; out of control.
examples: The shelter helps young runaways.
The police stopped the runaway truck.
He was a runaway at fifteen.

spanish.definition: Persona que se fue de su casa; fuera de control.

definition: To change in order to fit a new situation.
examples: Kids adapt quickly to a new school.
We have to adapt to the new rules.
They adapted the book into a movie.

spanish.definition: Cambiar para ajustarse a una situación nueva.

definition: Old and of high quality.
examples: He collects vintage cars.
She found a vintage dress at the market.
This is a vintage guitar from the 1960s.

spanish.definition: Viejo y de alta calidad.

definition: A building with law courts.
examples: They got married at the courthouse.
Reporters waited outside the courthouse.
The courthouse is next to city hall.

spanish.definition: Edificio con salas de justicia.

definition: A strong light on a stage; public attention.
examples: The singer stood in the spotlight.
She doesn't like being in the spotlight.
The spotlight is on the new mayor.

spanish.definition: Luz fuerte en un escenario; atención pública.

definition: The state of being alone or separate.
examples: Old people often suffer from isolation.
The patient is in isolation.
He lived in isolation for years.

spanish.definition: Estado de estar solo o separado.

definition: A long, narrow piece of cloth used for tying things.
examples: She tied a ribbon in her hair.
The gift had a red ribbon on it.
The mayor cut the ribbon at the new school.

spanish.definition: Pedazo largo y estrecho de tela para amarrar cosas.

definition: A metal part that closes a belt; to close a belt.
examples: His belt has a big silver buckle.
Buckle your seat belt.
She buckled her son into his car seat.

spanish.definition: Parte de metal que cierra un cinturón; cerrar un cinturón.

definition: A small bed with high sides for a baby.
examples: The baby is sleeping in her crib.
We put the crib in our room.
He built a crib for his son.

spanish.definition: Cama pequeña con lados altos para un bebé.

definition: A person who makes or fixes clothes.
examples: I took my suit to the tailor.
My grandfather was a tailor.
The tailor made the pants shorter.

spanish.definition: Persona que hace o arregla ropa.

definition: A tall pipe that takes smoke out of a building.
examples: Smoke was coming out of the chimney.
Santa Claus comes down the chimney.
The old factory has a tall chimney.

spanish.definition: Tubo alto que saca el humo de un edificio.

definition: A small paper or plastic bag with something in it.
examples: She added a packet of sugar to her tea.
The teacher gave us a homework packet.
I found a packet of seeds in the drawer.

spanish.definition: Bolsa pequeña de papel o plástico con algo adentro.

definition: Made at home.
examples: I love homemade bread.
She brought a homemade pie.
These homemade cookies are the best.

spanish.definition: Hecho en casa.

definition: A toy that flies in the wind on a long string.
examples: We flew a kite at the beach.
The kite got stuck in a tree.
My dad made me a kite.

spanish.definition: Juguete que vuela con el viento en una cuerda larga.

definition: A word with the same ending sound as another; to have the same ending sound.
examples: The word cat rhymes with hat.
Kids love nursery rhymes.
Can you find a rhyme for "blue"?

spanish.definition: Palabra con el mismo sonido final que otra; tener el mismo sonido final.

definition: A math statement that two things are equal.
examples: Solve this equation for x.
The equation is on the board.
We learned a new equation in math class.

spanish.definition: Enunciado matemático de que dos cosas son iguales.

definition: A small, green, sour fruit.
examples: Add some lime juice to the fish.
I'd like a soda with lime.
She squeezed a lime over the tacos.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña, verde y ácida.

definition: A strong will to do something difficult.
examples: She finished the race through pure determination.
His determination impressed the coach.
It takes determination to learn a language.

spanish.definition: Voluntad fuerte de hacer algo difícil.

definition: A river animal with a wide, flat tail.
examples: Beavers build dams in rivers.
We saw a beaver near the lake.
A beaver cut down that tree.

spanish.definition: Animal de río con cola ancha y plana.

definition: A messy pile of things.
examples: His clothes were in a heap on the floor.
There's a heap of dirty dishes in the sink.
The old car ended up in a heap of metal.

spanish.definition: Pila desordenada de cosas.

definition: A child's word for stomach.
examples: My tummy hurts.
The baby has a full tummy.
She rubbed the little boy's tummy.

spanish.definition: Palabra de niños para el estómago.

definition: A terrible event that causes great damage.
examples: The earthquake was a catastrophe.
We're trying to avoid a catastrophe.
The party was a complete catastrophe.

spanish.definition: Hecho terrible que causa mucho daño.

definition: In addition to what was said.
examples: It's cheap. Moreover, it's very good.
The plan is too expensive; moreover, it won't work.
He's a great teacher and, moreover, a kind man.

spanish.definition: Además de lo que se dijo.

definition: An open public area in a town; a group of stores.
examples: We sat in the plaza and ate ice cream.
The band played in the main plaza.
There's a new shopping plaza near my house.

spanish.definition: Área pública abierta en un pueblo; grupo de tiendas.

definition: A brown metal; a medal for third place.
examples: The statue is made of bronze.
She won a bronze medal.
They won the bronze in the last Olympics.

spanish.definition: Metal marrón; medalla del tercer lugar.

definition: Not able to do something.
examples: He's incapable of telling the truth.
She's incapable of hurting anyone.
They seem incapable of working together.

spanish.definition: Que no puede hacer algo.

definition: A channel along a street or roof that carries rainwater.
examples: We need to clean the gutters.
The ball rolled into the gutter.
Leaves are blocking the gutter.

spanish.definition: Canal en una calle o un techo que lleva el agua de lluvia.

definition: To give money or help for something.
examples: Everyone contributed five dollars.
She contributes a lot to the team.
Smoking contributed to his illness.

spanish.definition: Dar dinero o ayuda para algo.

definition: A flat, round object; a part of a computer that stores information.
examples: My hard disk is full.
He hurt a disk in his back.
Save the file on the disk.

spanish.definition: Objeto plano y redondo; parte de una computadora que guarda información.

definition: Something that makes it hard to move or to do something.
examples: Money is the main obstacle.
She overcame many obstacles in her life.
The race has an obstacle course.

spanish.definition: Algo que hace difícil moverse o hacer algo.

definition: A hard pink or white material formed in the sea.
examples: We saw beautiful coral while we were diving.
The coral is dying because the water is too warm.
Fish swam around the coral.

spanish.definition: Material duro rosado o blanco que se forma en el mar.

definition: A small, soft American bread roll.
examples: We had biscuits and gravy for breakfast.
She bakes great biscuits.
Would you like butter on your biscuit?

spanish.definition: Pan pequeño y suave típico de Estados Unidos.

definition: A head injury from being hit.
examples: He got a concussion playing football.
The doctor said she has a concussion.
You could get a concussion without a helmet.

spanish.definition: Lesión en la cabeza por un golpe.

definition: A very strong feeling of not liking something.
examples: She looked at the food with disgust.
He walked away in disgust.
I felt disgust at what he said.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento muy fuerte de que algo no te gusta.

definition: To begin to happen.
examples: Call me if any problems arise.
A new problem arose last week.
Questions have arisen about the money.

spanish.definition: Empezar a pasar.

definition: A person who leads an orchestra; a person who checks tickets on a train.
examples: The conductor raised her hands.
The train conductor asked for my ticket.
He's the conductor of the city orchestra.

spanish.definition: Persona que dirige una orquesta; persona que revisa boletos en un tren.

definition: The state of being male or female.
examples: Do you know the baby's gender?
Everyone should get equal pay regardless of gender.
Spanish nouns have a gender.

spanish.definition: Estado de ser hombre o mujer.

definition: A serious disagreement.
examples: They're in a dispute over money.
The two neighbors had a dispute about the fence.
The workers ended their dispute with the company.

spanish.definition: Desacuerdo serio.

definition: A small container of medicine you swallow; a small spaceship.
examples: Take one capsule twice a day.
The space capsule landed in the ocean.
I can't swallow big capsules.

spanish.definition: Recipiente pequeño de medicina que se traga; nave espacial pequeña.

definition: To tie something; to hold people together.
examples: They bound his hands with rope.
Love binds a family together.
She's binding the papers with string.

spanish.definition: Amarrar algo; mantener unidas a las personas.

definition: The hard outside part of bread or a pie.
examples: My son won't eat the crust.
I like pizza with a thin crust.
This pie has a great crust.

spanish.definition: Parte exterior dura del pan o de un pastel.

definition: A group of things tied together.
examples: She carried a bundle of clothes.
He gave me a bundle of old letters.
A bundle of firewood costs five dollars.

spanish.definition: Grupo de cosas amarradas juntas.

definition: To change something into another form.
examples: They converted the garage into a bedroom.
She converted to Islam.
How do I convert this file to a PDF?

spanish.definition: Cambiar algo a otra forma.

definition: A line of rock or coral near the top of the sea.
examples: The boat hit a reef.
We went diving at the coral reef.
Many fish live on the reef.

spanish.definition: Línea de roca o coral cerca de la superficie del mar.

definition: Very bad; making you feel ashamed.
examples: His behavior was shameful.
It's shameful how they treat their workers.
That was a shameful loss.

spanish.definition: Muy malo; que te hace sentir vergüenza.

definition: Done as part of a plan.
examples: We made a strategic decision.
The store has a strategic location.
The company needs a strategic plan.

spanish.definition: Hecho como parte de un plan.

definition: The smallest part of a chemical element.
examples: Everything is made of atoms.
A water molecule has three atoms.
Scientists can split an atom.

spanish.definition: Parte más pequeña de un elemento químico.

definition: To take things out of a car, a truck, or a ship.
examples: Help me unload the groceries.
They unloaded the truck in an hour.
He's unloading boxes from the van.

spanish.definition: Sacar cosas de un carro, un camión o un barco.

definition: Connected to a particular area of a country.
examples: She has a slight regional accent.
He's the regional manager.
We tried a lot of regional food in Italy.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con una zona particular de un país.

definition: To pay someone to work for you.
examples: The factory employs 300 people.
She's employed by a bank.
We can't employ anyone else right now.

spanish.definition: Pagarle a alguien para que trabaje para ti.

definition: To make someone angry on purpose; to cause a reaction.
examples: Don't provoke him.
His comments provoked a lot of anger.
She was trying to provoke a fight.

spanish.definition: Hacer enojar a alguien a propósito; causar una reacción.

definition: To change an event to a later time.
examples: They postponed the game because of rain.
We have to postpone the wedding.
Can we postpone our meeting until Friday?

spanish.definition: Cambiar un evento para más tarde.

definition: Covering a large area or amount.
examples: The fire caused extensive damage.
She has extensive experience in sales.
The hotel has extensive gardens.

spanish.definition: Que cubre una gran área o cantidad.

definition: Believing that good things will happen.
examples: I'm optimistic about the future.
She's always so optimistic.
The doctors are optimistic that he'll get better.

spanish.definition: Que cree que van a pasar cosas buenas.

definition: Strange and a little scary.
examples: That old house is really spooky.
We told spooky stories around the fire.
The woods are spooky at night.

spanish.definition: Raro y un poco aterrador.

definition: To move on ice or the ground with special shoes; one of these shoes.
examples: She learned to skate when she was four.
He was skating on the lake.
I need new ice skates.

spanish.definition: Moverse sobre el hielo o el suelo con zapatos especiales; uno de estos zapatos.

definition: A confusing set of paths.
examples: The kids got lost in the corn maze.
The old city is a maze of small streets.
Can the mouse find its way through the maze?

spanish.definition: Conjunto confuso de caminos.

definition: A place in the wall of a room for a fire.
examples: We sat by the fireplace.
The house has a stone fireplace.
She lit the fireplace on Christmas Eve.

spanish.definition: Lugar en la pared de un cuarto para hacer fuego.

definition: An insect with a hard, shiny back.
examples: A black beetle crawled across the floor.
My son found a beetle in the garden.
Some beetles can fly.

spanish.definition: Insecto de espalda dura y brillante.

definition: The quality of being stupid.
examples: I can't believe his stupidity.
It was an act of pure stupidity.
Her stupidity cost us the deal.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser estúpido.

definition: A student; the black circle in your eye.
examples: The school has 300 pupils.
The doctor looked at the patient's pupils.
She was my best pupil.

spanish.definition: Estudiante; círculo negro del ojo.

definition: A woman who welcomes guests; a woman who seats people in a restaurant.
examples: The hostess showed us to our table.
She's a wonderful hostess.
We thanked the hostess for the party.

spanish.definition: Mujer que recibe a los invitados; mujer que sienta a la gente en un restaurante.

definition: A combination of different things.
examples: Pour the mixture into the pan.
I felt a mixture of fear and joy.
This city is a mixture of old and new.

spanish.definition: Combinación de cosas distintas.

definition: A large, dangerous animal with sharp teeth that lives in rivers.
examples: We saw a crocodile in the river.
Crocodiles have very strong jaws.
The crocodile opened its mouth.

spanish.definition: Animal grande y peligroso con dientes afilados que vive en los ríos.

definition: The reason or desire to do something.
examples: I've lost my motivation to study.
What was his motivation for lying?
She doesn't need any motivation to work hard.

spanish.definition: Razón o deseo de hacer algo.

definition: A piece of art made from stone, wood, or metal.
examples: There's a large sculpture in the park.
She makes sculptures out of old metal.
The museum has a great sculpture collection.

spanish.definition: Obra de arte hecha de piedra, madera o metal.

definition: A good quality.
examples: The plan has some merit.
She got the job on merit.
Each idea has its merits.

spanish.definition: Buena cualidad.
